title: 第22章 和光同尘
content_zh:
“啊哟，陈大人，这边请，这边请。”魏乐府满脸热情的迎了过去。

    对方虽然要卸任了，但说到底也是升迁，人走茶凉也不至于这么快。

    该给的面子还是得给，而且还因为对方要离开了，给的更多。

    这种小事又不损伤利益，反而还能赚点名声，何乐而不为呢。

    陈佑卿见到魏乐府，也是受宠若惊的说道：“下官何德何能，让爵爷亲自前来迎接。”

    换做平日，都是他去觐见的，不过魏乐府为人和善，没有太多的架子。

    “陈大人要卸任咱们温池县的父母官。”魏乐府也是笑着说道：“今儿个算是给陈大人送别了。”

    “晚上这灵宴备的仓促，可莫要嫌弃。”

    听到魏乐府的调侃，陈佑卿也是赶忙说道：“不敢，爵爷这等豪迈，我喜爱都来不及呢，说甚嫌弃。”

    他怎么可能听不出魏乐府在谦虚，灵宴就是再仓促，规格还能低到哪里去？

    特别是魏乐府这位清浦县男可是出了名的大方。

    “哈哈哈，不嫌弃就好，不嫌弃就好。”魏乐府说着，就引着陈佑卿进了府邸。

    落座后，一众婢女就将灵宴摆了上来。

    酒过三巡后，陈佑卿这才开了口：“爵爷，之前你看重的那块地，下官已经连夜让人做好文书。”

    “明日爵爷请人去取便是。”

    “我两日后便要调任离开，有一事还请爵爷慎重。”

    这就要开始说正事了，至于说魏乐府看中的地，魏乐府出钱很大方，人家还巴不得卖了然后来给他当佃农。

    给魏乐府当佃农，那是真有肉吃。

    绝大部分百姓一年到头可都吃不了几顿荤腥的。

    “这般突然？”魏乐府没想到两天后就走，他还以为最少还得两三个月。

    这可打了他一个措手不及。

    魏乐府拍了拍手，在场的所有人员全都下去了。

    明显是接下来要说的话不适合外人听，不然陈佑卿也不至于提醒一句。

    “陈大人请说。”

    人走后，陈佑卿这才说道：“爵爷，您这价给的太高了，不只是咱们温池县的世家怨声载道。”
content_en:
"Ah, Mr. Chen, please come this way, please come this way." Wei Yuefu greeted him with enthusiasm.

Although the other party is about to resign, in the final analysis, it is still a promotion, and people will not leave so quickly.

You still have to give the face that should be given, and because the other party is leaving, you have to give more.

This kind of trivial matter does not harm the interests, but can also earn some reputation, so why not do it.

When Chen Youqing saw Wei Yuefu, he was also flattered and said: "How virtuous and capable I am, let the lord come to greet you in person."

On normal days, he would be the one to attend the meeting, but Wei Yuefu is a kind-hearted person and doesn't have too many airs.

"Master Chen is resigning as the parent officer of our Wenchi County." Wei Yuefu also said with a smile: "Today I can say goodbye to Master Chen."

"The spiritual banquet tonight has been prepared in a hurry, but don't resent it."

Hearing Wei Yuefu's teasing, Chen Youqing also hurriedly said: "I don't dare. I don't even have time to like your lordship for being so heroic. I even despise him."

How could he not hear that Wei Yuefu was being modest? No matter how hasty the spiritual banquet was, how much lower could the standards be?

Especially Wei Yuefu, a man from Qingpu County who is famous for his generosity.

"Hahaha, just don't dislike it, just don't dislike it." Wei Yuefu said, leading Chen Youqing into the mansion.

After sitting down, a group of maids set out the spiritual banquet.

After drinking for three rounds, Chen Youqing finally spoke: "Sire, sir, I have sent people to prepare paperwork overnight for the piece of land you valued previously."

"My lord, just ask someone to pick it up tomorrow."

"I will be transferred and leave in two days. Sir, please be careful about something."

Now it’s time to get down to business. As for the land that Wei Yuefu was interested in, Wei Yuefu paid very generously, and they were eager to sell it and work as tenant farmers for him.

Working as a tenant farmer in Wei Yue Mansion is a real way to earn money.

The vast majority of people cannot eat a few meaty meals throughout the year.

"So sudden?" Wei Yuefu didn't expect to leave in two days. He thought it would take at least two or three months.

This caught him off guard.

Wei Yuefu clapped his hands, and everyone present went down.

Obviously what he is about to say is not suitable for outsiders to listen to, otherwise Chen Youqing would not have warned him.

"Master Chen, please speak."

After they left, Chen Youqing said: "Sir, the price you paid is too high. It's not just the aristocratic families in Wenchi County who are complaining."
